summary: Backend + Frontend testing of new feature flag system + Accounting (8 pages) + HR / Tax / Asset / Bank Recon modules. Backend: 36/39 pytest passing (~92%). 1 real backend bug fixed (ObjectId in payroll slips). 1 real backend bug remaining (balance sheet returns balanced=false). 2 test-data collision issues mitigated. Frontend: visually verified — admin login OK, sidebar AKUNTING (PSAK) section with all 8 menu items, optional modules hidden by default, Settings → Aktivasi Modul section visible to admin with 5 module toggles (Accounting ON, others OFF), Jurnal Umum page renders 'Jurnal Manual Baru' form with seimbang/imbalance indicator + Posting button, and all 8 accounting routes return 200 without runtime errors.

critical.issue: Returns balanced=false on a freshly seeded db with valid posted journals. Equity contains 'Laba Tahun Berjalan' = -44.7M while Assets ≈ 167.95M and Liab+Equity ≠ Assets. Likely computation of Laba Tahun Berjalan or sign on revenue/expense accounts is off, OR seed/test journals don't fully balance. Spec requires balanced=true.

minor.issue: Used to return 500 because slips embedded raw ObjectId in employee_id field, FastAPI couldn't serialize. FIXED in this iteration by str(e['_id']).

Both reject re-running for an already-processed period_month with 400. That's fine, but combined with the lack of any 'reset for period' admin endpoint, test data accumulates and pollutes the balance sheet across iterations.
Validation OK — unbalanced 400, balanced 200. Confirmed reference_type='manual' is set.

Response shape changed since iteration 1 — no longer includes 'summary' / 'net_profit' top-level keys; older test_tms_backend.py::TestPnL::test_profit_loss now fails. Either restore the contract or update the legacy test.

integration_issues.flow: Settings → toggle HR ON → sidebar refresh
integration_issues.issue: Could not programmatically click the switch because element is not button[role="switch"]; visual confirmation shows toggles render correctly (green pill switches for ON, gray for OFF). Recommend adding data-testid='feature-toggle-{key}' to each switch and role='switch' for a11y + automation.

issues: React Router v6 future-flag warnings still spam the console (carried over from iter 1).
Sidebar brand changed to 'ARC BUSINESS SUITE' (was 'TMS / Order to Cash') — confirm with PM if rebrand was intentional.

action_items: FIX backend: GET /api/reports/balance-sheet must return balanced=true on clean seed. Audit the Laba Tahun Berjalan calculation (sign of revenue vs expense) and ensure every cost/payroll/depreciation/payment posts a balanced double-entry journal so that ΣAssets = ΣLiabilities + ΣEquity.
FIX backend: GET /api/reports/profit-loss broke its prior contract (no 'summary' / 'net_profit' keys). Restore or document.
ENHANCE frontend: add data-testid='feature-toggle-{key}' and role='switch' to each Aktivasi Modul toggle in Settings.js so automation can flip them.
MINOR backend: provide a way to re-run / overwrite a period for payroll & depreciation (or have DELETE for depreciation run) to keep test environments deterministic.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2455 lines — split into routers/{accounting,hr,tax,asset,bank_recon,feature_flags}.py before adding more modules.
run_payroll embedded ObjectId in slips (fixed). Audit other places that stash _id inside nested dicts before insert/return.

Balance sheet uses computed 'Laba Tahun Berjalan' on the fly — likely the bug source. Add an internal /api/debug/balance-check endpoint that returns ΣDebit vs ΣCredit per period to make this easier to diagnose.
FeatureGate component depends on FeatureFlagsProvider loading state — confirmed working: optional modules redirect off route when flag off, and sidebar hides them.

Settings page exposes Aktivasi Modul section to non-admin (finance can see it). Either hide entirely for non-admin or render disabled toggles with a tooltip 'Admin only'. Current visual + 403 enforcement at API level is acceptable but inconsistent UX.
Manual journal form has good UX: live 'Seimbang' / 'Tidak seimbang' indicator and disabled Posting button until balanced.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all routes render, all sidebar items present, manual journal form works; only toggle click in automation blocked by missing role/testid)

seed_data_creation: Backend seed unchanged. Tests use TEST_ prefix and period_month=2099-11/2099-12 to avoid collisions; some residual TEST_ employees and one TEST_Truck01 asset remain in db from this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes balance-sheet computation, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_modules_backend.py — only TestAccounting::test_balance_sheet_balanced and TestPnL::test_profit_loss should change state. The feature-flag/HR/asset/tax/bank-recon/manual-journal tests are stable and reusable. For frontend, when toggles get data-testid='feature-toggle-{key}', extend the playwright run to actually flip HR + verify 'Karyawan & Gaji' appears in sidebar (currently only visually verified via screenshot).
rca_of_the_issue: Balance-sheet imbalance — suspected root cause: either (a) Laba Tahun Berjalan is computed as revenue - expense with wrong sign convention (revenue accounts 4xxx typically have credit-normal balance, so naive sum may negate the value — observed -44.7M in equity), or (b) some cost/depreciation flows post one-sided journals. Repro: clean db, run TestAsset + TestHR + TestManualJournal, then GET /api/reports/balance-sheet → balanced=false. Mitigation: (1) audit post_journal callers in cost/payroll/depreciation routes; (2) fix sign convention on Laba Tahun Berjalan: equity_change = Σ(credit-debit) of 4xxx + Σ(debit-credit) of 5xxx/6xxx (revenue minus expense), not raw debit-credit. Payroll ObjectId bug RCA: run_payroll(server.py L2112) stored e['_id'] raw in slip dict; FastAPI's jsonable_encoder hit ObjectId on the response path and 500'd. Fixed by str(e['_id']).
